mapper.select: SELECT feishu_message_id FROM reminder_feishu_messages WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND rule_id = #{ruleId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reminder_feishu_messages (user_id, rule_id, feishu_message_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{ruleId}, #{feishuMessageId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE feishu_message_id = VALUES(feishu_message_id), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM reminder_feishu_messages WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND rule_id = #{ruleId}
